name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 107 - Am 54
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 107a. Recalls that, subject to the Treaties and EU law, the organisation, conduct and supervision of national elections remain the responsibility of the Member States; rejects any mandate for EU bodies to monitor or assess the lawful political positions or speech of parties, candidates or elected representatives;
